title: Nutty Portuguese Rice Fried-Rice
description: A hearty single-serving Portuguese fried rice with nutty flavor, cheese pull, and a touch of ground ginger, Ayurvedic sattvic-friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and ground ginger, cooking until fragrant about 30 seconds.
Stir in the cooked rice, breaking up any clumps and letting it toast lightly.
Pour in the soy sauce and season with salt, then mix until the rice is evenly coated.
Fold in the sliced almonds, ensuring they are warmed through.
Stir in the grated cheese until it begins to melt around the rice.
Add the chopped scallions and give one final stir to combine all flavors.
Serve immediately so the cheese remains pully and the rice stays warm.
Enjoy your nutty, cheese-pull Portuguese fried rice as a satisfying solo dinner.
